meta.title: Hominin fossil finds, 7 Ma–40 ka
meta.description: 32 fossil finds across deep time. Lines compare finds assigned to the same taxon; they do not establish ancestry. Ages and map locations are estimates.
meta.caveats: A selected sample, not a complete human family tree. Every point represents a fossil occurrence, not a species origin or a lifespan. Grey marks identify estimated dates and approximate regional locations; the fossils themselves are documented. Links are editorial comparisons within museum taxonomic groups, not ancestors, descendants or migrations. Clear selection to see inference in grey. Ranges and one-sided ages are explained on the cards; the picture shows display anchors, not uncertainty distributions. Modern geography is a reference backdrop, not a reconstruction of ancient coastlines.

linkKinds.comparison: comparison within a published taxonomic group

nodes.label: Kabwe 1
nodes.note: The 2020 direct-dating study gives 299 ± 25 ka (2σ). The museum groups this fossil as Homo heidelbergensis; its taxonomic assignment is debated. The point uses the central age estimate, not a precise year of death. Location is an estimated regional marker, not an excavation coordinate.

nodes.label: Irhoud 3
nodes.note: Homo sapiens. The 2017 study recalculates the age of a tooth in Irhoud 3 to 286 ± 32 ka; this replaces the museum page’s older 160 ka estimate. The separate 315 ± 34 ka estimate concerns the associated archaeological context. Location is an estimated regional marker, not an excavation coordinate.

nodes.label: Omo I
nodes.dateLabel: Older than a 233 ± 22 ka dated horizon
nodes.note: Homo sapiens. The 2022 study dates an overlying volcanic horizon, establishing a minimum age, not the fossil’s exact age. Plotted at 233 ka as a lower-bound display anchor; its actual position belongs farther into the past. This replaces the museum page’s older 195 ka estimate. Location is an estimated regional marker, not an excavation coordinate. No chronological comparison link is drawn from this one-sided age constraint.
